description: This file exports a list of optional bundled cluster identifiers, functions to check inclusion and release status, and utility functions related to optional bundled clusters in the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: isOptionalBundledCluster
methods.description: Checks if the given cluster is part of the optional bundled clusters set.

methods.name: shouldIncludeOptionalBundledClusters
methods.description: Determines whether optional bundled clusters should be included based on environment variables.

methods.name: hasReleasedBundledInstall
methods.description: Checks if a given package.json object indicates a released bundled install via openclaw configuration.

methods.name: shouldBuildBundledCluster
methods.description: Decides whether a specific cluster should be built, considering release status, environment, and options.
